scenarios.who: 同事老張 Coworker Lao Zhang
scenarios.intro: Party small talk, the sequel: trade hobbies, find common ground, and turn it into weekend plans.

them.zh: Eric，你平常下班都做什麼？
them.py: Eric, nǐ píngcháng xiàbān dōu zuò shénme?
them.en: Eric, what do you usually do after work?

turns.task: Say you like listening to music and watching movies.

ans.zh: 我喜歡聽音樂，也喜歡看電影。
ans.py: Wǒ xǐhuān tīng yīnyuè, yě xǐhuān kàn diànyǐng.
ans.en: I like music, and movies too.

them.zh: 喔？我也愛看電影！你喜歡哪種？
them.py: Ō? Wǒ yě ài kàn diànyǐng! Nǐ xǐhuān nǎ zhǒng?
them.en: Oh? I love movies too! What kind?

turns.task: Ask him back first — what kind does HE like?

ans.zh: 你先說，你喜歡哪種？
ans.py: Nǐ xiān shuō, nǐ xǐhuān nǎ zhǒng?
ans.en: You first — what kind do you like?

them.zh: 我喜歡動作片，越熱鬧越好！
them.py: Wǒ xǐhuān dòngzuòpiàn, yuè rènào yuè hǎo!
them.en: Action movies — the louder the better!

turns.task: Same! Say this weekend there's a new one — invite him.

ans.zh: 我也是！這個週末有一部新的，要不要一起去看？
ans.py: Wǒ yě shì! Zhège zhōumò yǒu yí bù xīn de, yào bú yào yìqǐ qù kàn?
ans.en: Same! There's a new one this weekend — want to go together?

them.zh: 好啊！星期六下午可以嗎？
them.py: Hǎo a! Xīngqí liù xiàwǔ kěyǐ ma?
them.en: Sure! Saturday afternoon work?

turns.task: Saturday afternoon works — you'll buy the tickets.

ans.zh: 可以！票我來買。
ans.py: Kěyǐ! Piào wǒ lái mǎi.
ans.en: Works! I'll get the tickets.

them.zh: 讚！那飲料我請！
them.py: Zàn! Nà yǐnliào wǒ qǐng!
them.en: Sweet! Drinks on me then!

turns.task: Deal — see you Saturday!

ans.zh: 成交！星期六見！
ans.py: Chéngjiāo! Xīngqí liù jiàn!
ans.en: Deal! See you Saturday!

scenarios.intro: The victory party is loud, and the mic is coming your way. Survive your first KTV number with borrowed courage and a duet.

them.zh: Eric！換你了！麥克風給你！
them.py: Eric! Huàn nǐ le! Màikèfēng gěi nǐ!
them.en: Eric! Your turn! Take the mic!

turns.task: Panic politely: you don't sing well — you don't know these songs!

ans.zh: 我唱得不好，這些歌我都不會啦！
ans.py: Wǒ chàng de bù hǎo, zhèxiē gē wǒ dōu bú huì la!
ans.en: I'm a terrible singer — I don't know any of these!

them.zh: 沒關係啦！我幫你點一首簡單的。
them.py: Méi guānxi la! Wǒ bāng nǐ diǎn yì shǒu jiǎndān de.
them.en: Doesn't matter! I'll queue you an easy one.

turns.task: Negotiate: okay, but she has to sing it WITH you.

ans.zh: 好，可是妳要跟我一起唱！
ans.py: Hǎo, kěshì nǐ yào gēn wǒ yìqǐ chàng!
ans.en: Fine — but you're singing it with me!

them.zh: 成交！那我們唱這首，很多人都會。
them.py: Chéngjiāo! Nà wǒmen chàng zhè shǒu, hěnduō rén dōu huì.
them.en: Deal! Let's do this one — everyone knows it.

turns.task: Look at the screen — admit the song looks a bit fast!

ans.zh: 欸，這首看起來有一點快欸！
ans.py: Éi, zhè shǒu kàn qǐlái yǒu yìdiǎn kuài éi!
ans.en: Uh — this one looks a little fast!

them.zh: （唱完）哇，你唱得不錯嘛！
them.py: (chàng wán) Wā, nǐ chàng de búcuò ma!
them.en: (after the song) Wow, you're not bad!

turns.task: Credit her — it's because she helped; next one is her solo!

ans.zh: 因為妳幫我啊！下一首妳自己唱！
ans.py: Yīnwèi nǐ bāng wǒ a! Xià yì shǒu nǐ zìjǐ chàng!
ans.en: Only because you helped! Next one's your solo!

them.zh: 沒問題，看我的拿手歌！
them.py: Méi wèntí, kàn wǒ de náshǒu gē!
them.en: No problem — watch my signature song!

turns.task: Hype her up — everyone clap, here comes the star!

ans.zh: 大家拍手！我們的歌星要上場了！
ans.py: Dàjiā pāishǒu! Wǒmen de gēxīng yào shàngchǎng le!
ans.en: Everyone clap — our star is taking the stage!

scenarios.intro: Eight people, one victory to celebrate. Compare packages, confirm what's bottomless, and book the room like the logistics officer you are.

them.zh: 歡迎光臨！請問幾位？
them.py: Huānyíng guānglín! Qǐngwèn jǐ wèi?
them.en: Welcome! How many?

turns.task: Eight people — ask what packages they have.

ans.zh: 八位。請問你們有什麼方案？
ans.py: Bā wèi. Qǐngwèn nǐmen yǒu shénme fāng'àn?
ans.en: Eight. What packages do you have?

them.zh: 三小時的，或是歡唱到凌晨的，送兩份小吃。
them.py: Sān xiǎoshí de, huòshì huānchàng dào língchén de, sòng liǎng fèn xiǎochī.
them.en: Three hours, or sing-till-dawn with two free snack plates.

turns.task: Ask: are drinks all-you-can-drink in both?

ans.zh: 兩種方案飲料都是喝到飽嗎？
ans.py: Liǎng zhǒng fāng'àn yǐnliào dōu shì hē dào bǎo ma?
ans.en: Are drinks bottomless in both packages?

them.zh: 對，都喝到飽。食物另外算。
them.py: Duì, dōu hē dào bǎo. Shíwù lìngwài suàn.
them.en: Yes, both bottomless. Food is separate.

turns.task: Everyone works tomorrow — take the three-hour package, and ask for a medium room.

ans.zh: 明天大家要上班，我們選三小時的。麻煩給我們一間中包廂。
ans.py: Míngtiān dàjiā yào shàngbān, wǒmen xuǎn sān xiǎoshí de. Máfán gěi wǒmen yì jiān zhōng bāoxiāng.
ans.en: Everyone works tomorrow — three hours it is. A medium room, please.

them.zh: 好的，中包廂一間，一位三百五。怎麼付款？
them.py: Hǎo de, zhōng bāoxiāng yì jiān, yí wèi sānbǎi wǔ. Zěnme fùkuǎn?
them.en: Sure — one medium room, 350 per person. How are you paying?

turns.task: The boss is treating tonight — one card, all together.

ans.zh: 今天主管請客，全部一起算，刷這張卡。
ans.py: Jīntiān zhǔguǎn qǐngkè, quánbù yìqǐ suàn, shuā zhè zhāng kǎ.
ans.en: Boss's treat tonight — all together, on this card.

them.zh: 好的！805包廂，祝你們唱得開心！
them.py: Hǎo de! Bā líng wǔ bāoxiāng, zhù nǐmen chàng de kāixīn!
them.en: Done! Room 805 — sing your hearts out!

turns.task: Thank them — tonight you're celebrating something big!

ans.zh: 謝謝！我們今天要慶祝一件大事！
ans.py: Xièxie! Wǒmen jīntiān yào qìngzhù yí jiàn dàshì!
ans.en: Thanks! We've got something big to celebrate tonight!

scenarios.intro: Back at the office: deliver the Kaohsiung report like a pro — outcome first, terms confirmed, next steps owned. Then accept the KTV invitation you've earned.

them.zh: Eric，高雄的情況怎麼樣？
them.py: Eric, Gāoxióng de qíngkuàng zěnmeyàng?
them.en: Eric — how did Kaohsiung go?

turns.task: Lead with the outcome: very smooth — they confirmed signing next month in Kaohsiung.

ans.zh: 非常順利！對方確認下個月在高雄簽約。
ans.py: Fēicháng shùnlì! Duìfāng quèrèn xià ge yuè zài Gāoxióng qiānyuē.
ans.en: Extremely smooth — they've confirmed signing next month in Kaohsiung.

them.zh: 太好了！條件都談定了嗎？
them.py: Tài hǎo le! Tiáojiàn dōu tán dìng le ma?
them.en: Excellent! Are the terms all settled?

turns.task: Report the numbers: ten units, 5% discount, six-week delivery — same as quoted.

ans.zh: 都談定了：十台，百分之五的折扣，交貨六個星期，跟報價一樣。
ans.py: Dōu tán dìng le: shí tái, bǎifēnzhī wǔ de zhékòu, jiāohuò liù ge xīngqí, gēn bàojià yíyàng.
ans.en: All settled: ten units, 5% off, six-week delivery — exactly as quoted.

turns.keys: 十台百分之五六個星期

them.zh: 董事長那邊呢？有什麼特別的要求？
them.py: Dǒngshìzhǎng nàbiān ne? Yǒu shénme tèbié de yāoqiú?
them.en: And the chairman? Any special requests?

turns.task: He focused on after-sales, as predicted — and he wants a long-term cooperation framework discussed at the signing.

ans.zh: 他果然最在意售後服務。另外他希望簽約的時候，談長期合作的架構。
ans.py: Tā guǒrán zuì zàiyì shòuhòu fúwù. Lìngwài tā xīwàng qiānyuē de shíhòu, tán chángqí hézuò de jiàgòu.
ans.en: After-sales, as predicted. He also wants to discuss a long-term cooperation framework at the signing.

them.zh: 很好，這是大機會。接下來你要做什麼？
them.py: Hěn hǎo, zhè shì dà jīhuì. Jiē xiàlái nǐ yào zuò shénme?
them.en: Good — that's a big opportunity. What are your next steps?

turns.task: Own it: organize the details and email them today; send the contract for legal review this week.

ans.zh: 我今天把細節整理好寄給您，這星期把合約送法務審查。
ans.py: Wǒ jīntiān bǎ xìjié zhěnglǐ hǎo jì gěi nín, zhè xīngqí bǎ héyuē sòng fǎwù shěnchá.
ans.en: I'll organize and email the details today, and send the contract to legal this week.

them.zh: 漂亮。今晚KTV慶功，我請客——你必須唱一首！
them.py: Piàoliàng. Jīnwǎn KTV qìnggōng, wǒ qǐngkè — nǐ bìxū chàng yì shǒu!
them.en: Beautiful. KTV tonight to celebrate, my treat — and you MUST sing one!

turns.task: Accept with terms: for this deal, you'll sing two — but nobody's allowed to record it.

ans.zh: 為了這個案子，我唱兩首！但是不准錄影！
ans.py: Wèile zhège ànzi, wǒ chàng liǎng shǒu! Dànshì bù zhǔn lùyǐng!
ans.en: For this deal I'll sing TWO — but absolutely no filming!

scenarios.zh: 訪談：台灣品牌走向世界
scenarios.intro: Tonight's OPI drill: can Taiwan's SMEs escape the OEM shadow and build world-facing brands? Thesis, evidence, concession, strategy — with your own deal as Exhibit A.

them.zh: 台灣產品品質好是有名的，但是國際品牌很少。你覺得為什麼？
them.py: Táiwān chǎnpǐn pǐnzhí hǎo shì yǒumíng de, dànshì guójì pǐnpái hěn shǎo. Nǐ juéde wèishénme?
them.en: Taiwan is famous for quality, yet has few global brands. Why, in your view?

turns.task: Root cause: decades of OEM success — great at making, underinvested in name recognition and storytelling.

ans.zh: 我認為是代工太成功了：我們很會做東西，但是在知名度和說故事上投資太少。
ans.py: Wǒ rènwéi shì dàigōng tài chénggōng le: wǒmen hěn huì zuò dōngxi, dànshì zài zhīmíngdù hàn shuō gùshì shàng tóuzī tài shǎo.
ans.en: OEM was too successful — we're great at making things, but underinvested in name recognition and storytelling.

them.zh: 那中小企業有機會建立自己的品牌嗎？
them.py: Nà zhōngxiǎo qǐyè yǒu jīhuì jiànlì zìjǐ de pǐnpái ma?
them.en: Do SMEs even have a shot at building their own brands?

turns.task: Yes — in emerging industries: no entrenched giants yet, so drones and green energy are open ground.

ans.zh: 有，重點在新興產業：無人機、綠能這些領域還沒有巨頭，正是建立品牌的空間。
ans.py: Yǒu, zhòngdiǎn zài xīnxīng chǎnyè: wúrénjī, lǜnéng zhèxiē lǐngyù hái méiyǒu jùtóu, zhèng shì jiànlì pǐnpái de kōngjiān.
ans.en: Yes — in emerging industries. Drones and green energy have no entrenched giants yet; that's exactly the space to build a brand.

them.zh: 可是打品牌要花很多錢，中小企業負擔得起嗎？
them.py: Kěshì dǎ pǐnpái yào huā hěnduō qián, zhōngxiǎo qǐyè fùdān de qǐ ma?
them.en: But branding costs a fortune — can SMEs afford it?

turns.task: Concede the constraint, then flip it: they can't outspend, so they should out-focus — one niche, one story, done excellently.

ans.zh: 預算確實有限，所以不能拚廣告量，要拚專注：選一個利基市場，把一個故事說到最好。
ans.py: Yùsuàn quèshí yǒuxiàn, suǒyǐ bùnéng pīn guǎnggào liàng, yào pīn zhuānzhù: xuǎn yíge lìjī shìchǎng, bǎ yíge gùshì shuō dào zuì hǎo.
ans.en: Budgets are limited, so don't compete on ad volume — compete on focus: pick one niche and tell one story excellently.

them.zh: 你自己公司最近好像也有好消息？
them.py: Nǐ zìjǐ gōngsī zuìjìn hǎoxiàng yě yǒu hǎo xiāoxí?
them.en: Your own company had some good news lately, I hear?

turns.task: Exhibit A: your team just secured a Taiwanese client — trust built through testing, dinners, and gifts, not ads. Relationships are the SME's brand.

ans.zh: 對，我們剛談成一個台灣客戶的案子。靠的不是廣告，是測試、吃飯和伴手禮建立的信任——對中小企業來說，關係就是品牌。
ans.py: Duì, wǒmen gāng tánchéng yíge Táiwān kèhù de ànzi. Kào de búshì guǎnggào, shì cèshì, chīfàn hàn bànshǒulǐ jiànlì de xìnrèn — duì zhōngxiǎo qǐyè láishuō, guānxì jiùshì pǐnpái.
ans.en: Yes — we just closed a deal with a Taiwanese client. Not through ads, but trust built by tests, dinners, and gifts. For SMEs, relationships ARE the brand.

them.zh: 「關係就是品牌」，講得真好！恭喜你們，也謝謝分享！
them.py: 'Guānxì jiùshì pǐnpái', jiǎng de zhēn hǎo! Gōngxǐ nǐmen, yě xièxie fēnxiǎng!
them.en: 'Relationships are the brand' — well said! Congratulations, and thanks for sharing!

turns.task: Thank the host — tonight you celebrate; next month, the signature.

ans.zh: 謝謝主持人！今晚先慶功，下個月，正式簽約！
ans.py: Xièxie zhǔchírén! Jīnwǎn xiān qìnggōng, xià ge yuè, zhèngshì qiānyuē!
ans.en: Thanks! Tonight we celebrate — next month, we sign!

x: 我工作的時候喜歡聽音樂。
Wǒ gōngzuò de shíhòu xǐhuān tīng yīnyuè.
I like listening to music while working.
這部電影超好看！
Zhè bù diànyǐng chāo hǎokàn!
This movie is amazing!
vocab.n: Movies count with 部: 一部電影. 電影院 = the cinema.

x: 她週末喜歡畫畫。
Tā zhōumò xǐhuān huàhuà.
She likes drawing on weekends.
vocab.n: First 畫 is the verb, second the noun — verb-object compounds double like 唱歌, 睡覺.

x: 我在看一本很有意思的書。
Wǒ zài kàn yì běn hěn yǒu yìsi de shū.
I'm reading a really interesting book.
vocab.n: Books count with 本. 看書 = to read (not 讀書, which leans 'to study').

x: 你有什麼興趣？
Nǐ yǒu shénme xìngqù?
What are your hobbies?
vocab.n: 對…有興趣 = interested in…: 我對無人機很有興趣 — small talk to sales pitch in one pattern.

x: 我們訂了一個大包廂。
Wǒmen dìng le yíge dà bāoxiāng.
We booked a big private room.
vocab.n: KTV rooms and restaurant private rooms both; 包 = reserved/wrapped for you.

x: 換你點歌了！
Huàn nǐ diǎngē le!
Your turn to pick a song!
vocab.n: Same 點 as ordering food — you 'order' songs from the machine. 切歌 = skip someone's song (dangerous move).

x: 麥克風的聲音太小了。
Màikèfēng de shēngyīn tài xiǎo le.
The mic's volume is too low.
vocab.n: Loanword from English; casually shortened to 麥 (拿麥 = take the mic).

x: 你們有什麼優惠方案？
Nǐmen yǒu shénme yōuhuì fāng'àn?
What deals/packages do you have?
vocab.n: KTV packages, phone plans, and business proposals all — 解決方案 = solution, your industry's favorite word.

x: 我們輪流開車，比較不累。
Wǒmen lúnliú kāichē, bǐjiào bú lèi.
We take turns driving — less tiring.
這是我媽的拿手菜。
Zhè shì wǒ mā de náshǒu cài.
This is my mom's signature dish.
vocab.n: 拿手歌 signature song, 拿手菜 signature dish — the things you pull out to impress.

vocab.e: to stay up late, pull a late night
x: 我昨天熬夜看球賽，好累。
Wǒ zuótiān áoyè kàn qiúsài, hǎo lèi.
I stayed up for the game — exhausted.
vocab.n: 熬 = to simmer/endure. 爆肝 (exploding liver) is the slang upgrade for extreme cases.

x: 我們先交換一下聯絡方式。
Wǒmen xiān jiāohuàn yíxià liánluò fāngshì.
Let's exchange contact info first.
vocab.n: 交換名片 the card ritual, 交換意見 exchange views, 交換學生 exchange student.

x: 這次拜訪的成果很好。
Zhècì bàifǎng de chéngguǒ hěn hǎo.
The visit produced great results.
vocab.n: The report word: 成果報告 results briefing. Fruits (果) of effort — more concrete than 結果.

x: 謝謝你們的招待！
Xièxie nǐmen de zhāodài!
Thank you for your hospitality!
vocab.n: The guest's thank-you line after any hosted meal. 招待所 = guesthouse.

x: 案子談成了，今晚開慶功宴！
Ànzi tánchéng le, jīnwǎn kāi qìnggōngyàn!
Deal closed — victory banquet tonight!
vocab.n: 慶功 celebrate-the-achievement + 宴 banquet. Teams 開 (hold) them after wins of any size.

x: 中小企業是台灣經濟的基礎。
Zhōngxiǎo qǐyè shì Táiwān jīngjì de jīchǔ.
SMEs are the foundation of Taiwan's economy.
vocab.n: Abbreviated 中小企 in headlines; over 97% of Taiwanese companies qualify.

x: 公司計畫拓展海外市場。
Gōngsī jìhuà tuòzhǎn hǎiwài shìchǎng.
The company plans to expand overseas.
vocab.n: Formal expansion — markets, business, territory. 業務拓展 = business development, the BD in job titles.

x: 外銷訂單連續三個月成長。
Wàixiāo dìngdān liánxù sān ge yuè chéngzhǎng.
Export orders grew three months straight.
vocab.n: 銷 = to sell: 外銷 sell abroad, 內銷 domestic sales, 熱銷 selling hot.

x: 這個品牌的知名度越來越高。
Zhège pǐnpái de zhīmíngdù yuèláiyuè gāo.
This brand's recognition keeps climbing.
vocab.n: The -度 suffix measures things: 能見度 visibility, 滿意度 satisfaction, 難度 difficulty.

slang.e: to hit the next venue, afterparty
x: KTV唱完要不要續攤吃宵夜？
KTV chàng wán yào bú yào xùtān chī xiāoyè?
After KTV, next stop for late-night eats?
slang.n: Taiwan essential: 攤 (stall/round) + 續 (continue). A proper night out is measured in 攤s.

slang.e: hyped to the max, off the rails (fun)
x: 昨天的慶功宴大家都嗨翻了！
Zuótiān de qìnggōngyàn dàjiā dōu hāifān le!
Everyone went absolutely wild at the victory party!
slang.n: Taiwan youth: 嗨 (high, from English) + 翻 (flipped over). 玩嗨了, 嗨歌 — the party register.

x: 王先生招待的海鮮超澎湃！
Wáng xiānshēng zhāodài de hǎixiān chāo phong-phài!
Mr. Wang's seafood spread was gloriously lavish!
slang.n: Hokkien: the highest compliment for a table of food. Mandarin reading péngpài means 'surging' — the Hokkien sense rules in Taiwan.

x: 他一拿麥克風就不放，標準麥霸。
Tā yì ná màikèfēng jiù bú fàng, biāozhǔn màibà.
Once he grabs the mic it never comes back — textbook mic hog.
slang.n: Mainland internet: 麥 (mic) + 霸 (tyrant), fully adopted in Taiwan KTV culture. Don't be one.

x: 他唱那首老歌，大家都破防了。
Tā chàng nà shǒu lǎo gē, dàjiā dōu pòfáng le.
He sang that old song and everyone's composure crumbled.
slang.n: Mainland gaming term (armor break) turned emotion-speak; now pan-Chinese for when something hits you right in the feelings.
